title: D-pinitol ameliorated H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative damage in PC12 cells and prolonged the lifespan by IIS pathway in Caenorhabditis elegans.
authors: Zhang, Miaosi; Xu, Zhe; Shao, Liangyong; Wang, Jilite; He, Zouyan; Jiang, Yumei; Zhang, Ye; Wang, Hao
journal: Comparative biochemistry and physiology. Toxicology & pharmacology : CBP
one_liner_zh: 该文研究D-pinitol通过IIS通路抗衰老，仅用分子对接初步涉及蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: D-pinitol (DP) has been extensively regarded as the main active component of legumes for anti-aging. In this study, we intended to explore the anti-aging mechanism of DP, utilizing computer modeling techniques. The results demonstrated that DP significantly delayed H(2)O(2)-induced cellular senescence. Model PC12 cells treated with DP exhibited increased cell viability, increased antioxidant enzyme activity (SOD, CAT), and reduced ROS and MDA levels. Furthermore, DP was discovered to have a positive effect on healthy longevity. In C. elegans, DP treatment enhanced lifespan, stress capacity, antioxidant capacity (T-SOD/CAT/GSH-Px/MDA/ROS), and altered aging-related indicators of lipofuscin accumulation, pharyngeal pump rate, motility, and reproduction. Moreover, DP could reduce the toxicity Abeta in transgenic C. elegans CL4176, CL2355, and CL2331. Further mechanistic studies indicated DP increased transcription factor (daf-16, skn-1, hsf-1) expression of insulin/insulin-like growth factor-1 signaling (IIS) pathway. As expected, DP also extended the downstream target genes of the three transcription factors (sod-3, ctl-1, ctl-2, gst-4, hsp-16.1, and hsp-16.2). Further mutant lifespan experiments, network pharmacology, and molecular docking revealed that DP might be life-extending through the IIS pathway. DP deserves extensive investigation and development as a potential anti-aging drug in the future.
abstract_zh: D-松醇（DP）已被广泛认为是豆科植物中主要的抗衰老活性成分。在本研究中，我们旨在利用计算机建模技术探索DP的抗衰老机制。结果表明，DP显著延缓了H(2)O(2)诱导的细胞衰老。经DP处理的模型PC12细胞表现出细胞活力增加、抗氧化酶活性（SOD、CAT）增强，以及ROS和MDA水平降低。此外，发现DP对健康长寿具有积极作用。在秀丽隐杆线虫中，DP处理延长了寿命、增强了应激能力、抗氧化能力（T-SOD/CAT/GSH-Px/MDA/ROS），并改变了与衰老相关的指标，如脂褐素积累、咽泵速率、运动能力和繁殖能力。此外，DP能降低转基因线虫CL4176、CL2355和CL2331中Aβ的毒性。进一步的机制研究表明，DP增加了胰岛素/胰岛素样生长因子-1信号（IIS）通路中转录因子（daf-16、skn-1、hsf-1）的表达。如预期所料，DP也延长了这三个转录因子的下游靶基因（sod-3、ctl-1、ctl-2、gst-4、hsp-16.1和hsp-16.2）。进一步的突变体寿命实验、网络药理学和分子对接揭示，DP可能通过IIS通路延长寿命。DP值得在未来作为潜在的抗衰老药物进行广泛研究和开发。
